# California State University, Northridge (CSUN)

> > California State University, Northridge is a comprehensive public university serving the San Fernando Valley and greater Los Angeles region with academic programs across engineering, computer science, business, and liberal arts.

CSUN is home to specialized colleges including the Andrew J. Anagnost College of Engineering & Computer Science (ACECS) and the David Nazarian College of Business and Economics. The university provides extensive student services, facility booking systems, and academic resources through departments like Academic Resources & Planning and Faculty Affairs.
